ed_reconstruction.values: quantile-mapped to each location's observed NSSP distribution

ed_target_transform.boundary_policy: Clip response-link inputs only; do not alter truth or predictor history
ed_target_transform.name: logit

notices: Iowa ED: using older data (last reported 2026-06-27), without wastewater.

base-peak-height.historical_vintage_policy: frozen current snapshot, not exact historical issue vintages
base-peak-height.label_source: complete Base hospitalization history: reconstructed seed and era-adjusted observations
base-peak-height.observed_peak_policy: current-season maximum in Base history is fixed; revisions update next run

base-peak-timing.distribution: past-peak classifier plus conditional lognormal future weekly-bin mass
base-peak-timing.gate_objective: binary log loss: final peak on or before observed anchor
base-peak-timing.historical_vintage_policy: frozen current snapshot, not exact historical issue vintages
base-peak-timing.label_source: unique maxima of complete Base reconstructed and era-adjusted hospitalization history
base-peak-timing.observed_peak_policy: past mass split over reported maxima; no observed seasonal values implies future-only; terminal support implies past-only
base-peak-timing.response_transform: log((final peak date - observed anchor date) / 7 days), conditional on positive lead
base-peak-timing.weighting: equal total weight per location-season in each median and spread fit
